mechanism_narrative: A high level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate applied to future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 4.5% (over the last 5 years).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates an accommodative monetary policy and a tightening labor market, which together boost corporate earnings and investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE decline) does not produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances (over the last 5 years), or the Rank IC for the interaction term is not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime (HOUST rising above 1600 thousand units), increased construction activity and consumer confidence drive stronger economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1600 (over the last 5 years).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between PAYEMS and 20-day SPX returns is not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index above 200 signals elevated inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 200 (over the last 5 years).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 indicates a contraction in manufacturing and industrial activity, which reduces corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110 (over the last 5 years).

mechanism_narrative: In a consumer spending recovery regime (RSAFS rising above 360,000 million dollars), increased retail sales drive economic growth and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 360000 (over the last 5 years).
